item.title: Privacy Policy
item.description:
Meexle (“we”, “us”, “our”) operates meexle.com. This page informs you of our policies regarding the collection, use, and disclosure of personal information when you interact with us through this site.

What we collect. When you contact us by email or via any form on this site, we collect the information you provide — typically your name, email address, optional company name and phone number, and the contents of your message. We do not deploy cookies or third-party advertising trackers on this site.
